column1: Clause    2  :  This  clause  inserts  new  section  43B  in  the  Code  of  Criminal  Procedure  Act,
No.  15  of  1979  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  amendment  is  to  confer  a  duty  on  the  Magistrates
to  visit  police  stations  within  his  judicial  division  to  ensure  that  the  suspects  in  the  custody
of  such  police  stations  are  protected  to  the  extent  provided  for  in  the  Convention  Against
